body:
> Let's discuss those changes next time, this is stylistic change we need to agree.

I completely agree on this, I started this PR because of the differences in `lib/main.js` https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/710/files#diff-dbd1065ebaf59b9c5fec54631b2e5e06L10 where it was inconsistent. The path I chose was easily doable with sed, when the other way around wasn't.
I have no preference, I just love consistency.
